correctness.rationale: Non-line triangles uniquely classify by the row/column corner and odd n excludes four-cliques; the nerve of 3n line simplices collapses along n^2 free edges to a connected graph. Every loop is a homotopic image of a periodic torus edge loop because every graph edge lies in a line simplex; both torus generators bound disks in row/column simplices, so pi1=0. Euler characteristic 1+(n-1)^3 and a 2-dimensional CW model, Hurewicz and homology Whitehead give the exact integral wedge. Direct graph-clique enumeration and independent mod-two boundaries tested n=3,5,7,9 and do not replace the proof.
